trickyParts: Replay budget: the settings frame is paid first and whole, then commands keep the host-order prefix that fits what is left (#fitCommands re-runs whenever settings change, so a settings change can republish a shorter commands frame); order is history, settings, commands last. A 5,000-model test pins it.
The header never shows a value the session did not report: values come only from the latest settings frame by seq; the switch outcome is the reply to that message id, independent of frame order.
Pickers appear only when the session reports settings AND its commands frame lists the built-in model/effort without terminalOnly (decision 6).
Send is held via assistant-ui's isSendDisabled (AgentRuntimeThread sendDisabled prop) so typed text stays editable while a switch is pending.

What each oracle records (asked for vs happened): a settings frame and RPC get_state report the model the session has selected for its next turn (asked for); /effort reports the configured level (asked for); the session file's assistant message `model` and `model_change` role `fallback` record what ran (happened). The rig's picker-model check reads both: get_state after the pick and the next turn's assistant message model in the session file.
deviations: Decision 8 case 3 refined in the simplify pass: a later failed attempt reads `The session answered: <error>` only when it is the session's own error reply (`rowAnsweredWithError`: failed with an envelope id); a failure Dispatch recorded itself reads `No answer came from the session: <error>`, as the POST-time failure does. Unit-tested both ways.
packages/pi-shared/test/host-registry.ts (outside Task 2's list) gained the four optional getters so envoy tests need no casts.
packages/dispatch/web/src/features/agent-view/AgentRuntimeThread.tsx (outside Task 4's list) gained a sendDisabled prop to hold Send while a switch is pending.
No contracts unit test: decision 1 defines no type guard (Task 1 asks for one only for a guard).
The rig's check 2 is three named checks (terminal-set-model, terminal-set-thinking, terminal-typed-effort), so a passing run prints 20 ok lines for the plan's 18 checks.
The rig falls back to /opt/omp/bin/omp for LEGION_TEST_OMP: no omp is on PATH in this pod.
